project.description: Manages the Network templates associated to each Networks via Jenkins

hudson.model.TextParameterDefinition.name: operation
hudson.model.TextParameterDefinition.description: One of these: create, update or delete a Campus network

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: owner
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Webapp username that owns the network (gets read/build/cancel on its jobs)

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: team_group
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Jenkins group of the team the network is shared with (gets read), e.g. team-3; empty for none

PATH=$PATH:/var/jenkins_scripts/ export PATH
echo operation=\"${operation}\" "${src}" "${network_name}" "${hosts}" "${network_desc}" echo src=\"${src}\" echo network_name=\"${network_name}\" echo hosts=\"${hosts}\" echo network_desc=\"${network_desc}\" echo owner=\"${owner}\" team_group=\"${team_group}\"
print_error() { echo "$@" ; exit 1; }
source_folder=${src%.*} dest_folder=${source_folder}-${network_name} project_yaml="${dest_folder}/project.yaml" DEFAULT="--default--"

args = parser.parse_args()
# e.g project_yaml => /project/build-and-test-vdc-001 network_name = args.n[0] network_desc = args.d[0] project_yaml = args.f[0]
project_yaml_dst = project_yaml + ".ext" project_dict = {}

action_suffix= "(" + network_name + ")"
for job in jobs_list:
job["name"] = job["name"] + action_suffix job["jenkins_url"] = job["jenkins_url"] + "-" + network_name
except Exception as e: print("Exception while processing Network project YAML...") print(str(e))
# Dump updated dictionary overwriting project.yaml with open(project_yaml, "w") as new: try: yaml.dump(project_dict, new, default_flow_style=False)
except Exception as e: print("Exception while processing Network project YAML...") print(str(e)) ' -n $network_name -d "$network_name created using the NITA webapp" -f $project_yaml

JENKINS_SERVER_URL = "http://jenkins:8080/jenkins" JENKINS_SERVER_USER = os.getenv("JENKINS_USER", "admin")
import http.cookiejar, json, urllib.error, urllib.parse, urllib.request # Jenkins (reverse-proxy realm) trusts X-Forwarded-User from inside the cluster; # the crumb is bound to the session cookie, so reuse one opener for both calls. _opener = urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.HTTPCookieProcessor(http.cookiejar.CookieJar())) _identity = {"X-Forwarded-User": JENKINS_SERVER_USER}
def jenkins_post(path, body=b"", content_type=None, tolerate=()): crumb = json.load(_opener.open(urllib.request.Request(JENKINS_SERVER_URL + "/crumbIssuer/api/json", headers=_identity), timeout=30)) headers = dict(_identity) headers[crumb["crumbRequestField"]] = crumb["crumb"] if content_type: headers["Content-Type"] = content_type try: with _opener.open(urllib.request.Request(JENKINS_SERVER_URL + path, data=body, headers=headers, method="POST"), timeout=60) as resp: status = resp.status except urllib.error.HTTPError as err: status = err.code if status in (200, 201, 302) or status in tolerate: print("Jenkins POST", path, "->", status) return status raise SystemExit("Jenkins POST %s failed: HTTP %s" % (path, status))
from xml.sax.saxutils import escape def acl_property_xml(owner, team_group): # Mirrors the webapp: owner and team members read/build/cancel (deleting a # network is a webapp operation, not a job permission); admins and power # users inherit from the global matrix (InheritParentStrategy). perms = [] if owner: perms += ["USER:hudson.model.Item.%s:%s" % (p, escape(owner)) for p in ("Read", "Build", "Cancel")] if team_group: perms += ["GROUP:hudson.model.Item.%s:%s" % (p, escape(team_group)) for p in ("Read", "Build", "Cancel")] return ("<hudson.security.AuthorizationMatrixProperty>" "<inheritanceStrategy class=\"org.jenkinsci.plugins.matrixauth.inheritance.InheritParentStrategy\"/>" + "".join("<permission>%s</permission>" % p for p in perms) + "</hudson.security.AuthorizationMatrixProperty>") ACL_XML = acl_property_xml(os.environ.get("owner", "").strip(), os.environ.get("team_group", "").strip())
with open("./project.yaml", "r") as stream: try: input = yaml.safe_load(stream) ansible_jobs_template = Template(ANSIBLE_JOBS_CONFIG) test_jobs_template = Template(TEST_JOBS_CONFIG) for action_item in input["action"]: print ("action_item", action_item) if "custom_workspace" in action_item["configuration"].keys() and action_item["configuration"]["custom_workspace"]: action_item["configuration"]["custom_workspace"] = CURRENT_DIR + "/" + action_item["configuration"]["custom_workspace"] else: action_item["configuration"]["custom_workspace"] = CURRENT_DIR template = ansible_jobs_template action_item["acl"] = ACL_XML
if action_item["category"].upper() == TEST_CATEGORY: action_item["configuration"]["output_path"] = CURRENT_DIR + "/" + str(action_item["configuration"]["output_path"]) template = test_jobs_template
output = template.render(action_item) #print "output", output job_name = action_item["jenkins_url"] print("creating Jenkins job", job_name) # 400 = job already exists (e.g. re-run of create); keep going. jenkins_post("/createItem?name=" + urllib.parse.quote(job_name), output.encode(), "text/xml; charset=utf-8", tolerate=(400,)) except Exception as e: print("Exception while installing the Jenkins Jobs...") print(e) print(traceback.print_exc()) print(traceback.format_exc()) raise SystemExit(1) ' || print_error "Installing the Jenkins jobs for ${network_name} failed" else print_error "Source Template Directory: ${src} does not exists or (network_name or project.yaml content recevied is null)" fi fi
if [ "${operation}" = "update" ]; then if [ "${hosts}" != "${DEFAULT}" -a -d "$dest_folder" ]; then echo "updating hosts file..." echo "${hosts}" > $dest_folder/hosts; else print_error "Update hosts: Campus Network Directory: $dest_folder does not exists" fi fi

JENKINS_SERVER_URL = "http://jenkins:8080/jenkins" JENKINS_SERVER_USER = os.getenv("JENKINS_USER", "admin") _opener = urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.HTTPCookieProcessor(http.cookiejar.CookieJar())) _identity = {"X-Forwarded-User": JENKINS_SERVER_USER}
def acl_property_xml(owner, team_group): perms = [] if owner: perms += ["USER:hudson.model.Item.%s:%s" % (p, escape(owner)) for p in ("Read", "Build", "Cancel")] if team_group: perms += ["GROUP:hudson.model.Item.%s:%s" % (p, escape(team_group)) for p in ("Read", "Build", "Cancel")] return ("<hudson.security.AuthorizationMatrixProperty>" "<inheritanceStrategy class=\"org.jenkinsci.plugins.matrixauth.inheritance.InheritParentStrategy\"/>" + "".join("<permission>%s</permission>" % p for p in perms) + "</hudson.security.AuthorizationMatrixProperty>")
def set_job_acl(job_name, acl_xml): job_url = JENKINS_SERVER_URL + "/job/" + urllib.parse.quote(job_name) try: config = _opener.open(urllib.request.Request(job_url + "/config.xml", headers=_identity), timeout=30).read() except urllib.error.HTTPError as err: if err.code == 404: print("job", job_name, "does not exist; skipping") return raise root = ET.fromstring(config) props = root.find("properties") if props is None: props = ET.SubElement(root, "properties") for old in props.findall("hudson.security.AuthorizationMatrixProperty"): props.remove(old) props.append(ET.fromstring(acl_xml)) crumb = json.load(_opener.open(urllib.request.Request(JENKINS_SERVER_URL + "/crumbIssuer/api/json", headers=_identity), timeout=30)) headers = dict(_identity, **{crumb["crumbRequestField"]: crumb["crumb"], "Content-Type": "text/xml; charset=utf-8"}) with _opener.open(urllib.request.Request(job_url + "/config.xml", data=ET.tostring(root), headers=headers, method="POST"), timeout=60) as resp: print("updated permissions of", job_name, "->", resp.status)
acl_xml = acl_property_xml(os.environ.get("owner", "").strip(), os.environ.get("team_group", "").strip()) with open("./project.yaml", "r") as stream: for action_item in yaml.safe_load(stream)["action"]: set_job_acl(action_item["jenkins_url"], acl_xml) ' || print_error "Updating the Jenkins job permissions for ${network_name} failed" else print_error "ACL update: Campus Network Directory: $dest_folder does not exists" fi fi

def jenkins_delete_job(job_name): crumb = json.load(_opener.open(urllib.request.Request(JENKINS_SERVER_URL + "/crumbIssuer/api/json", headers=_identity), timeout=30)) headers = dict(_identity) headers[crumb["crumbRequestField"]] = crumb["crumb"] try: with _opener.open(urllib.request.Request(JENKINS_SERVER_URL + "/job/" + urllib.parse.quote(job_name) + "/doDelete", data=b"", headers=headers, method="POST"), timeout=60) as resp: status = resp.status except urllib.error.HTTPError as err: status = err.code # 404 = already gone; anything else unexpected fails the build. print("deleting Jenkins job", job_name, "->", status) if status not in (200, 302, 404): raise SystemExit("deleting Jenkins job %s failed: HTTP %s" % (job_name, status))
